verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents ready-made instrumentation integrations. These include a drop-in `wrap_openai` wrapper that automatically logs OpenAI SDK calls, Anthropic SDK tracing, Go `trace/contrib` auto-instrumentation, a no-code Java agent, and a general claim of integrations with "AI providers and frameworks". However, only the OpenAI SDK among the named examples is concretely evidenced; LangChain and the Vercel AI SDK are never mentioned. A community comment that "integration options are limited" is general skepticism, not a concrete counter-example, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. missing for 10: documented LangChain integration, documented Vercel AI SDK integration, independent/hands-on corroboration of the framework integrations.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument my app through existing integrations for frameworks like LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or the Vercel AI SDK

citations.quote: Braintrust provides `wrap_openai`, a drop-in wrapper around the OpenAI client that automatically logs all LLM calls to Braintrust.
Integrate with AI providers and frameworks to send traces to Braintrust
The recommended way to capture AI calls is auto-instrumentation: use the `trace/contrib` packages to instrument supported provider libraries
attach the Braintrust Java Agent at JVM startup and supported clients are traced with no code changes
Trace Anthropic SDK calls, evaluate Claude models, and route them through the Braintrust gateway
